-- brick breaker: single screen
fl=4
fr=123
ft=18
py=112
ph=4
pw=20
pww=32
ps=3
br=2
spd0=2.2
spdmax=3
wlen=45
clen=120

state="title"
prevo=false
prevx=false
score=0
lives=3
broken=0
spd=spd0
ticks=0
lastwall=-99

function cprint(t,y,c)
 print(t,flr((128-#t*4)/2),y,c)
end

function rowcol(r)
 if r<2 then return 12 end
 if r==2 then return 11 end
 if r==3 then return 10 end
 if r==4 then return 9 end
 return 8
end

function build_bricks()
 bricks={}
 for r=0,5 do
  for c=0,7 do
   local hp=1
   if r<2 then hp=2 end
   add(bricks,{x=8+c*14,y=24+r*7,w=14,h=6,hp=hp,r=r})
  end
 end
end

function newball()
 b={x=pad.x+pad.w/2,y=py-3,vx=0,vy=0,stuck=true}
end

function new_game()
 score=0
 lives=3
 broken=0
 spd=spd0
 ticks=0
 lastwall=-99
 pad={x=54,y=py,w=pw,wide=0,cool=0}
 build_bricks()
 newball()
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(6,100,3)
end

function set_pad_w(w)
 local cx=pad.x+pad.w/2
 pad.w=w
 pad.x=mid(fl,cx-w/2,fr+1-w)
end

function launch()
 if not b.stuck then return end
 b.stuck=false
 local a=rnd(0.16)-0.08
 b.vx=spd*sin(a)
 b.vy=-spd*cos(a)
 sfx(0,3)
end

function wallhit()
 if ticks-lastwall>3 then
  lastwall=ticks
  sfx(18,3)
 end
end

function overlap(k)
 return b.x-2<=k.x+k.w-1 and b.x+1>=k.x and b.y-2<=k.y+k.h-1 and b.y+1>=k.y
end

function harm(i)
 local k=bricks[i]
 if k.hp>1 then
  k.hp-=1
  score+=5
 else
  deli(bricks,i)
  score+=20
  broken+=1
  if broken%8==0 then spd=min(spdmax,spd+0.12) end
 end
 sfx(16,3)
end

function hitx(sx)
 if sx==0 then return false end
 for i=1,#bricks do
  local k=bricks[i]
  if overlap(k) then
   if sx>0 then
    b.x=k.x-2
   else
    b.x=k.x+k.w+2
   end
   harm(i)
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end

function hity(sy)
 if sy==0 then return false end
 for i=1,#bricks do
  local k=bricks[i]
  if overlap(k) then
   if sy>0 then
    b.y=k.y-2
   else
    b.y=k.y+k.h+2
   end
   harm(i)
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end

function fix_slope()
 if abs(b.vy)<0.45 then
  b.vy=b.y<64 and 0.45 or -0.45
  local m=sqrt(b.vx*b.vx+b.vy*b.vy)
  if m>0 then
   b.vx=b.vx*spd/m
   b.vy=b.vy*spd/m
  end
 end
end

function pad_hit()
 if b.vy<=0 then return end
 if b.x+1<pad.x or b.x-2>pad.x+pad.w-1 then return end
 if b.y+1<py or b.y-2>py+ph-1 then return end
 b.y=py-2
 local rel=(b.x-(pad.x+pad.w/2))/(pad.w/2)
 rel=mid(-1,rel,1)
 if abs(rel)<0.08 then
  rel=rnd(1)<0.5 and -0.08 or 0.08
 end
 local a=rel*0.19
 b.vx=spd*sin(a)
 b.vy=-spd*cos(a)
 sfx(17,3)
end

function ball_step()
 local d=sqrt(b.vx*b.vx+b.vy*b.vy)
 local steps=max(1,flr(d/1.2)+1)
 for i=1,steps do
  local sx=b.vx/steps
  b.x+=sx
  if b.x-2<fl then
   b.x=fl+2
   b.vx=abs(b.vx)
   wallhit()
  elseif b.x+1>fr then
   b.x=fr-1
   b.vx=-abs(b.vx)
   wallhit()
  end
  if hitx(sgn(sx)) then
   b.vx=-b.vx
   fix_slope()
  end
  local sy=b.vy/steps
  b.y+=sy
  if b.y-2<ft then
   b.y=ft+2
   b.vy=abs(b.vy)
   wallhit()
  end
  if hity(sgn(sy)) then
   b.vy=-b.vy
   fix_slope()
  end
  pad_hit()
  if b.y-2>127 then return true end
 end
 return false
end

function lose_life()
 lives-=1
 if lives<=0 then
  finish(false)
 else
  sfx(2,3)
  newball()
 end
end

function finish(won)
 state=won and "win" or "over"
 music(-1,200)
 if won then
  sfx(3,3)
 else
  sfx(4,3)
 end
end

function update_pad(xp)
 if btn(0) then pad.x-=ps end
 if btn(1) then pad.x+=ps end
 if pad.wide>0 then
  pad.wide-=1
  if pad.wide<=0 then
   pad.wide=0
   set_pad_w(pw)
  end
 end
 if pad.cool>0 then pad.cool-=1 end
 if xp and pad.cool<=0 then
  pad.wide=wlen
  pad.cool=clen
  set_pad_w(pww)
  sfx(19,3)
 end
 pad.x=mid(fl,pad.x,fr+1-pad.w)
end

function _init()
 state="title"
 prevo=false
 prevx=false
 score=0
 lives=3
 broken=0
 spd=spd0
 ticks=0
 lastwall=-99
 pad={x=54,y=py,w=pw,wide=0,cool=0}
 build_bricks()
 newball()
 music(6,0,3)
end

function _update()
 local no=btn(4)
 local nx=btn(5)
 local o=no and not prevo
 local xp=nx and not prevx
 prevo=no
 prevx=nx
 if state=="title" then
  if o then
   new_game()
   state="play"
   launch()
  end
 elseif state=="play" then
  ticks+=1
  update_pad(xp)
  if b.stuck then
   b.x=pad.x+pad.w/2
   b.y=py-3
  else
   if ball_step() and state=="play" then lose_life() end
  end
  if state=="play" and #bricks==0 then finish(true) end
 else
  if o then
   new_game()
   state="play"
   launch()
  end
 end
end

function draw_field()
 rectfill(0,0,127,13,0)
 rectfill(0,14,127,17,5)
 rectfill(0,18,3,127,5)
 rectfill(124,18,127,127,5)
 rectfill(fl,ft,fr,127,1)
end

function draw_hud()
 print("SCORE "..score,2,3,7)
 for i=1,lives do
  rectfill(118-(i-1)*8,4,122-(i-1)*8,8,8)
 end
end

function draw_bricks()
 for k in all(bricks) do
  local c=rowcol(k.r)
  rectfill(k.x,k.y,k.x+k.w-1,k.y+k.h-1,c)
  rect(k.x,k.y,k.x+k.w-1,k.y+k.h-1,0)
  if k.hp>1 then
   rectfill(k.x+3,k.y+2,k.x+9,k.y+3,7)
  end
 end
end

function draw_paddle()
 local c=5
 if pad.wide>0 then
  c=14
 elseif pad.cool<=0 then
  c=11
 end
 rectfill(pad.x,py,pad.x+pad.w-1,py+ph-1,c)
 rectfill(pad.x+2,py+1,pad.x+pad.w-3,py+2,7)
end

function draw_cool()
 rectfill(fl,120,fr,122,1)
 if pad.cool<=0 then
  rectfill(fl,120,fr,122,11)
 else
  local g=1-pad.cool/clen
  local w=flr((fr-fl+1)*g)
  if w>0 then
   rectfill(fl,120,fl+w-1,122,12)
  end
 end
end

function draw_end(t,c)
 rectfill(20,44,107,83,0)
 rect(20,44,107,83,c)
 cprint(t,52,c)
 cprint("SCORE "..score,64,7)
 cprint("PRESS O",76,10)
end

function _draw()
 cls(0)
 if state=="title" then
  cprint("BREAKOUT",16,12)
  for r=0,2 do
   for c=0,7 do
    rectfill(12+c*14,32+r*7,25+c*14,37+r*7,rowcol(r))
   end
  end
  cprint("ARROWS: MOVE",64,7)
  cprint("O: SERVE BALL",76,6)
  cprint("X: WIDE PADDLE",88,6)
  cprint("3 LIVES - CLEAR BRICKS",100,5)
  cprint("PRESS O TO START",114,10)
 else
  draw_field()
  draw_bricks()
  draw_cool()
  draw_paddle()
  rectfill(b.x-2,b.y-2,b.x+1,b.y+1,7)
  draw_hud()
  if state=="play" and b.stuck then
   cprint("O: SERVE",96,6)
  end
  if state=="win" then
   draw_end("CLEAR!",11)
  elseif state=="over" then
   draw_end("GAME OVER",8)
  end
 end
end
title: 砖块突破

design.core_action: 左右移动挡板接球，把球打回砖块区；球在挡板上时按O发球
design.goal: 击碎全部48块砖（顶部两排需命中两次）获胜，三条命用尽失败
design.risk: 球落到屏幕底部失一条命；每击碎8块砖球速提升；X加宽只持续45帧且有120帧冷却，要选时机；挡板只有4像素厚
design.controls: 方向左右移动挡板；标题按O开始并发球；失命后按O再发球；胜利/失败后按O重开；X加宽挡板（就绪时挡板变绿、底部条显示充能）；O与X都用上升沿，按住不重复触发
design.scenes: title → play → win/over，重开回到play并立即发球；结束状态停止移动、碰撞与生成
design.audiovisual: BGM用工坊原创pattern6（声道0/1）；声道3播自定义SFX16击砖、17击板、18撞墙、19加宽，内置0发球、2失命、3胜利、4失败；砖块按行配色，两命砖带白条，挡板颜色表示加宽中/就绪/冷却
preserve: 原有12个内置精灵与全部音频资源不变
30Hz、128x128、单玩家、方向键+O/X的工坊输入约定
unresolved: 球速上限3与加宽45帧/冷却120帧的手感是否合适，需要实际试玩后再调
